{{Quote|Still can't decide what to put in the sonic shower. Felucian glimmer-stones look so elegant, but I love Rylothian onyx tile.|Veedrig|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Rylothian onyx''' was a type of stone from [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. [[Veedrig]] considered tiling the [[Sonic shower/Legends|sonic shower]] in [[the Ark]] with Rylothian onyx.
